framings.text: A system that compounds itself into a durable, cohesive whole across the agentic software development lifecycle, letting you act as the restaurateur who tastes the final product: a healthy codebase and an easier next change.

supports.quote: a system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness
I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product
not just the trees, but the forest

framings.text: A human first board coordinating the entire agentic software development lifecycle from brain dump to a PR ready for human review, with rigor, durability, cohesion, and verification that preserve codebase health.

supports.quote: its a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle
it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human
that considers the health of the code base and makes the next change easier

outcome: You can taste a coherent final product spanning the brain dump, prompt, hunch, and intuition through a PR ready for human review, while seeing the health of the codebase, the next change made easier, and the whole agentic software development lifecycle held together by a human first board.

questions.text: Should compounding primarily improve the meta harness itself, the codebase it works on, or both?
